capabilities: Highlight PDF text by linking to text selections from Markdown notes
Copy links to selections, pages, and outline items with customizable templates and colors
Add, edit, and delete annotations saved directly inside PDF files
Extract, insert, remove, and reorder PDF pages while updating links across the vault
Filter, sync, and preview backlinks against the open PDF page
extras: Warns that the plugin relies on Obsidian private APIs and may break on Obsidian updates. Direct PDF editing is marked experimental with a data-corruption warning advising backups. Docs are described as a work in progress. Can be installed via BRAT for beta releases. Requires Obsidian v1.6.5+ for future updates. Some PDF++ features do not apply to annotations made by the Pdf Annotator plugin, and Close Similar Tabs is reported to conflict.
intentEvidence: PDF++ acts as a complement to Obsidian's native PDF viewer rather than replacing it.
motivation: The author dislikes plugins that store annotations in non-Markdown formats and wanted an Obsidian-native annotation workflow that survives the plugin disappearing.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer has no annotation support, and existing annotation plugins store notes in plugin-specific formats or require switching to external apps.

summary: PDF viewer enhancement that annotates PDFs via Markdown backlinks and adds link copying, embed controls, and page and outline editing to the built-in viewer.
